integrity: The finite claims were recomputed with exact rational arithmetic from the displayed formulas. The infinite exterior estimate is taken from and checked against the focal source's symbolic proof; no numerical experiment is used to replace it.
limitations: The result is method-level: it fixes Alpay's rational exterior field and ratio-gluing architecture. It does not claim global optimality among all Hardy certificates or reciprocal fields.
title: The radius-12 local correction for the eight-dimensional reciprocal Hardy field is cutoff-optimal
